All 4 features validated: (1) 4-prix-OCR-majority groups readings and records 1 ride with majority price; (2) RideAccessibilityService integrates tracker correctly (sameOffer=::sameOffer, offerVisible().forEach(::record), currentItem() for overlay, isKnown() for sound gating, no lastItem leftovers); (3) per-ride delete propagates DAO→Repo→VM→UI with confirmation dialog; (4) button text is 'Tout effacer'.

critical_code_review_comments: AcceptanceTracker.offerVisible returns List<Result<T>> (not Result? as before). Both call sites in RideAccessibilityService use .forEach(::record), and record() signature matches — verified ✓.

sameOffer in service uses totalDistanceKm ±max(0.6 km, 6%) with fallback to equal price when km is null. This correctly groups the user-reported 4 readings (10.5 km repeated) → one Slot with 4 votes for 10.03 (majority) + 1 each for 10.55/96.00/6.00 → recorded price is 10.03 ✓.
Slot.vote increments the per-key count; majority = votes.values.maxByOrNull { it.second }!!.first — ties resolved by LinkedHashMap insertion order (first-seen wins) which matches the test assertion.

decidedMemoryMs=180_000L: after decide(), the sample is stored in `decided` deque; recentlyDecided() uses sameOffer against the sample, not the majority, which is correct because sample is the first reading (any sibling km within tolerance will match).

isKnown() returns true for current/awaiting/recently-decided — RideAccessibilityService uses !isKnown(item) BEFORE offerVisible() to decide whether to play the sound → sound only on genuinely new offers ✓.

Overlay re-draw gated by `bestSignature == lastOfferSignature` where bestSignature is derived from acceptance.currentItem() (majority) → user sees the stable majority value and does not get flashing updates when OCR hallucinates a wrong price for one frame ✓.

UBER_CARD / BOLT_CARD regexes verified in source: '(?i)montant net de frais|course de \d|\buberx\b|\bcomfort\b|exclusivit|uber green|\buber ?van\b' and '(?i)net,? ?ttc|\bbolt\s?(green|xl|comfort|eco|premium)\b|forte demande'. Kotlin double-backslashes in source produce \d \b \s at regex level — compile-tested OK, Pattern.compile would accept.

platformFromCard(lines) ?: pkg is passed to parser.parseTexts in the OCR branch → if an Uber card is OCR'd while a Bolt bubble is the foreground pkg, the parser gets Uber rules ✓. If the card text matches neither UBER_CARD nor BOLT_CARD, it falls back to pkg (previous behavior preserved).

RideDao.deleteById(id: Long) is a Room @Query('DELETE FROM rides WHERE id = :id') suspend fun — correct signature. RideRepository.delete(id) wraps it. HistoryViewModel.delete(id) launches on viewModelScope — correct.
HistoryScreen.toDelete: var toDelete by remember { mutableStateOf<RideEntity?>(null) } — explicit type parameter present, required because initial value is null. ✓
AlertDialog pattern (toDelete?.let { ride -> AlertDialog(...) }) correctly scopes the lambda so `ride` is non-null inside the dialog body. ✓

Both RideCard call sites (pending at line 158 passing a trailing lambda for the 'extra' slot, and list at line 216 with default extra=null) match the new 4-arg signature (ride, highlight, onDelete, extra). ✓
material-icons-extended already in app/build.gradle.kts line 58; Icons.Filled.Delete is actually in material-icons-core (bundled with material3), either way the import resolves.

'Effacer' renamed to 'Tout effacer' on button (line 150); the dialog title/confirm button remain 'Effacer l'historique ?' / 'Effacer' which is the correct action verb inside the confirmation context (not a bug).
No stale references to `lastItem` or old nullable offerVisible return — grep confirms. onClick and onScreen still return Result<T>? and are consumed with ?.let { record(it) } — correct.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of the user-reported bug (confirmed by code reading + test 'une offre lue avec 4 prix differents = UNE seule course, prix majoritaire'): the previous AcceptanceTracker keyed each offer by its exact price string (parsed.grossPriceEuros via signature '${pkg}|${price}'). The Uber card re-renders ~every 300 ms and OCR occasionally mis-reads 10,03 € as 10,55 € or 96,00 € or 6,00 € (common OCR confusions: 03↔55, missing decimal → 96,00, dropped digit → 6,00). Each new price produced a new signature → a new offer slot → the previous slot was closed as PENDING ('Pas pris' when the home screen was next read) → 4 history rows in 6 minutes with 4 different prices for one real offer. FIX validated in this iteration: Slot now accumulates all readings keyed by price while the OCR distance stays within ±max(0.6 km, 6%) (sameOffer), returns the majority price as the recorded value, and remembers decided offers for 3 min via sameOffer so a stray re-read (e.g. 10,55 € 1 s later) is ignored (isKnown + recentlyDecided). RideAccessibilityService wires this with sameOffer=::sameOffer and calls isKnown() BEFORE offerVisible() to gate the sound (new-offer only). REPRO ON DEVICE for main-agent self-test: enable the service, open a real Uber offer and leave it visible for 10-15 s; previous build created ≥2 history rows with varying prices; current build creates ONE row with the most-often-read price. Per-ride delete: tap the trash IconButton on any card → 'Supprimer cette course ?' dialog → 'Supprimer' → row disappears; 'Tout effacer' still clears all rides.
